# ex: implicit & cancels with inner * in matched expression (paren-wrapped)
# Pattern p is *T, target has (*ptr).F where ptr is *T, so implicitOp='&'
# Matched expression is (*ptr), inner * cancels with implicit &
ex {
	var p *T
	p.F -> println(p.F, p)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ F int }

func f(ptr *T) {
	println((*ptr).F)
}
-- stderr --
x.go:6:10: println((*ptr).F, ptr) (no value) used as value
errors found after executing: ex { \ ...
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 type T struct{ F int }

 func f(ptr *T) {
-	println((*ptr).F)
+	println(println((*ptr).F, ptr))
 }
